Class PowerfulPotion

java.lang.Object
model.items.base.Potion
model.items.concrete.PowerfulPotion
All Implemented Interfaces:
Item
public class PowerfulPotion extends Potion
Represents a Powerful Potion that can be used by a PlayerCharacter.

Using this potion increases the player's attack power. Only CharacterType.WIZARD characters are allowed to use this potion.
